svg.title: Lockwork: Patent exploded view
svg.desc: Lockwork (1D): the stair-door pin tumbler drawn as a patent sheet, every part pulled apart along dotted axes and numbered. The tension wrench turns the plug while the hook pick lifts the one binding pin toward the dashed shear line; the spool pin waits beside it to give a false set. The tension gauge on the left sits inside its safe band.
